# Singularity design system
<!-- GENERATED by scripts/system/build.ts (npm run system). Do not edit. -->

Pick a part from this list before writing a class or a value. A part that fits is used as it is; none fits means ask the owner. Never invent a control class.
Detail of one: `npm run ds -- part <id>`. Search by need: `npm run ds -- find "<what you need>"`. Tokens: `npm run ds -- token <words>`. Everything: tokens/system.json.

## Parts
`id` classes: what it is. Use: when. Not: situation → part to use instead.
- `button-filled` .button-filled: The accent fill under its own words; the most prominent button. Use: It is the one action that commits a sheet, a dialog or an empty page: Save, Add category, Listen now; It saves or submits a form sheet, or confirms a dialog. Not: Another filled button is on the same surface: make the second one Tonal → button-tonal.
- `button-tonal` .button-tonal: The accent container under its own words, with no outline; quieter than Filled. Use: It is the alternative beside a Filled button; It is a labelled add or reorder action on a list: Add source, Add section, Reorder. Not: It is the only action that commits the surface → button-filled.
- `button-text` .button-text: An accent label with no container until it is hovered or pressed; the quietest button. Use: It dismisses, backs out or repeats: Cancel, Clear, Try again, Hide this; It sits beside a Filled button as the lesser choice. Not: The action must be found at a glance on its own → button-filled.
- `button-danger` .button-danger: A Text button in the danger colour. Use: It is the confirm of a delete, in a dialog that asks first: Delete, Delete source. Not: The action is not destructive, or nobody has been asked to confirm → button-text.
- `button-small` .button-small: A shorter pill, same touch target. Use: It sits in a dense row or a popover. Not: It commits a sheet → button-filled.
- `icon-btn` .icon-btn .press: A glyph in a round 44px target, quiet until used. Use: One glyph says what it does: Close, Back, More, Share; A row's dots menu, or the Close of a sheet. Not: It is the companion of a primary action: Share beside Play → icon-btn-tonal.
- `icon-btn-tonal` .icon-btn-tonal: A circle on the container fill, beside a primary action. Use: The companion of a primary action in one row: Share beside Play. Not: A lone toolbar glyph, or one in every row → icon-btn.
- `fab` .create-fab .create-fab-label: The page's one primary action below 64rem: a glyph and a word, floating. Use: One creating action a phone needs in reach: Catch up, Add a source. Not: The action sits in a form or a sheet → button-filled.
- `text-link` .text-link: A link inside a line of small text; the words stay inline, the target is 44px. Use: A link inside a hint, a sentence or a breadcrumb. Not: It stands alone as an action → button-text.
- `source-link` .source-link: The one link out of a story: the publisher's name, underlined on hover. Use: Name the publisher a story or a highlight came from. Not: It sits inside a sentence → text-link.
- `play-chip` .chip .chip-glyph: The tonal pill that plays a briefing or one story, with its state. Use: Play an episode or a story and show idle, current, played, error or preparing. Not: A person ticks a choice → filter-chip.
- `filter-chip` .filter-chip .filter-chips: A checkbox drawn as a pill; ticked it takes the accent container. Use: Tick several topics or categories to include; Filter a list by one or more kinds: the Library's Show chips. Not: Exactly one of a few values → segmented-choice.
- `segmented-choice` .segmented-choice .segmented-choice-item: One pill of radio items: pick exactly one value. Use: Choose one of two to four short values: Length, Format, Tone. Not: Switching between views → segmented-nav.
- `segmented-nav` .segmented-nav .segmented-nav-tab: A tonal track with one sliding pill: switch between views of the same content. Use: Switch the view of one page or panel without leaving it: a topic's Sources and Preferences. Not: Choosing the value of a setting → segmented-choice.
- `search-field` .search-field: The rounded search pill, on the container tone, with its glyph. Use: Search or filter a list by text: the Library, Sources, Downloads. Not: A text field in a form → field.
- `icon` .icon-glyph .icon-glyph-lg: A filled Phosphor glyph in the colour of the text beside it. Use: A mark beside a label or alone in a button: a chevron, a plus, a check, Play. Not: The glyph must act when pressed → icon-btn.
- `badge` .badge-label: A grey label holding one word or one number beside a name. Use: A short label names what the thing beside it is: Admin beside the wordmark; A count of what a section holds. Not: The state is good, worth a look or wrong → banner.
- `switch` .switch-input: A track and a thumb for one setting that is on or off. Use: A setting is on or off and applies as soon as it is flipped: Sounds, Autoplay, a podcast's Enabled; It sits at the end of a settings row, with the row's label as its name. Not: The choice is one of several values, or needs a Save to apply → filter-chip.
- `slider` .slider-input: A track with a thumb: a value between two ends, set by dragging or by the arrow keys. Use: The value is on a scale where nearby values are alike: Volume, Playback speed, a topic's weight. Not: There are two to five named options and none is between the others → filter-chip.
- `field` .field-input: An outlined box for text a person types: one line, or several lines (multiline). Use: A person types a short value or a few lines: a title, a feed address, a prompt; It sits under its own label in a form or a settings row. Not: The value is one of two to four short options → segmented-choice.
- `select` .select-outlined .select-tonal: A native select with its own chevron. Use: A person picks one value from a list of five or more, or of names that are too long for a row of chips; It sits under its own label in a form, or in a toolbar as a sort or a filter. Not: the value is one of two to four short options → segmented-choice.
- `menu` .menu-list .menu-sheet: A short list of actions that opens from an icon button: a row each, its glyph first. Use: A card, header or row has more actions than room: Download, Add to queue, Share, Delete; Each action is one tap, with no choice of its own. Not: The person picks one value from a list → select.
- `banner` .banner-notice .banner-text: A tinted block with an icon, a title, an optional line and at most one text button. Use: A state a person must know about stays on screen: offline, a failed run, a playback error. Not: A banner in the page would be moved around by a page change (a cover between pages) → banner.
- `toast` .toast-popover .toast-action: One quiet message at a time on the inverse surface, with an optional action. Use: A brief message with Undo after a delete; A failure that clears itself, or a partial save. Not: A notice that must stay → banner.
- `dialog` .dialog-panel .dialog-body: A small centred box with a heading and a row of buttons: one question, one tap. Use: A person confirms what cannot be undone: Delete, Discard, Switch profile. Not: The question needs fields to answer → sheet.
- `sheet` .sheet-side .sheet-head: A panel over the page for a form or a list: full screen on a phone, at the right from 40rem. Use: Something to fill in or edit that needs room: New episode, a topic, a source; A list over the page, dismissed by a pull or tap. Not: One question and its answers → dialog.
- `drawer` .drawer-scrim .drawer-viewport: The island modal for a form: the whole screen on a phone, a panel at the right from 40rem, with Close in the header. Use: A React island opens a form over the page, as Regenerate does. Not: The sheet is drawn by Astro or a script → sheet.
- `ripple` .ripple-area .ripple-wave: A wave from the touch point that fills a control's touch area, then fades. Use: A large touch target on a phone must show where it was pressed: a bottom bar tab. Not: A small control needs a press state → icon-btn.
- `btn-action-tonal` .btn-action-tonal: The one creating action in the side column (Catch up), on the action tone. Use: the Catch up action in the side column. Not: any other button → button-tonal.
- `tabs` .tabs-bar .tab: A sticky strip of links to the sections of one page. Use: jump to the sections of a briefing or an episode; tabs inside a card. Not: switching between two views → segmented-nav.
- `row-action` .row-action .settings-text: A row that is one link or button: the whole row responds as a rounded tile. Use: a settings row that opens a sub-page; a menu or list row that navigates. Not: a row that holds a switch or a select → settings-row.
- `card-group` .card-group .rows: A group of rows in one rounded container on the container tone. Use: group several settings rows; a card of chips. Not: a single stat or number → stat-tiles.
- `settings-row` .settings-row .settings-label: A row with a label and an in-place control: a switch, a select or a value. Use: a setting with a switch; a setting with a select. Not: a row that opens another page → row-action.
- `empty-state` .empty .empty-actions: A spot illustration, a title, one line and at most two actions, for a page with nothing in it. Use: a page or section with nothing to list yet; no results, offline, not found. Not: a list that has items → card-group.
- `multiselect` .multiselect-trigger: A field-like trigger that opens a list of checkable choices. Use: choose several from a long list; pick sources or topics in a field. Not: a few choices that fit on screen → filter-chip.
- `stat-tiles` .stat-tiles: A tile per figure: the value large over its word in muted ink. Use: figures on a dashboard; costs and spend totals. Not: a list of rows → card-group.
- `section-head` .section-head: A section header with more room above than below, so it belongs to what follows. Use: title a group of rows or cards on a page.
- `meta` .meta: One quiet line of facts, separated by centered dots. Use: date, duration and source under a title.
- `cover` .cover: A generated cover image, drawn once per theme. Use: show an episode or briefing cover.

## Color roles
Components read only these (never a hex, never a primitive color).
- --color-surface: Page background.
- --color-surface-sunken: Wells, inputs, hover fills, track backgrounds.
- --color-surface-container: The tonal fill of a control that sits on the page: the search pill, a play chip, a second…
- --color-surface-raised: Sheets and dialogs.
- --color-surface-overlay: Floating chrome: mini player, popovers.
- --color-surface-inverse: Toasts.
- --color-on-surface
- --color-on-surface-reading: Running text read under a heading in on-surface: a story's summary, an episode highlight.
- --color-on-surface-muted: Secondary text.
- --color-on-surface-disabled: Disabled controls only.
- --color-on-surface-inverse
- --color-border-hairline: Decorative dividers.
- --color-border-control: Boundary of an input or segmented control.
- --color-track: Rail and scrubber track.
- --color-track-strong: Unplayed item ticks and upcoming nodes.
- --color-accent: Lingonberry.
- --color-accent-subtle: Tint behind the current row.
- --color-on-accent-container: Text and icons on accent-container.
- --color-accent-container-high: The tone of an action that is not a place: the New episode buttons.
- --color-on-accent-container-high: Text and icons on accent-container-high.
- --color-accent-action: The tone of the one creating action in the side column (Catch up).
- --color-on-accent-action: Text and icons on accent-action, at 4.5:1 in rest, hover and press.
- --color-on-accent
- --color-cover-accent: Defaults to the accent.
- --color-on-cover-accent
- --color-focus-ring
- --color-focus-gap: Inner ring color.
- --color-scrim: Dims the page behind a sheet, dialog, drawer or picker.
- --color-on-scrim: Words on the scrim over a cover.
- --color-accent-on-inverse: The accent on the inverse surface (a toast), the other theme's step: 5.4:1.
- --color-image-outline: 1px outline on covers for perceived edge, per DESIGN.md.
- --color-success
- --color-success-subtle
- --color-warning
- --color-warning-subtle
- --color-danger
- --color-danger-subtle
- --color-favorite: The filled heart.
- --color-favorite-glow: The heart's halo.
- --color-info
- --color-info-subtle
- <fill>-hover and <fill>-pressed for --color-accent, --color-accent-container, --color-accent-container-high, --color-accent-action, --color-surface, --color-surface-sunken, --color-surface-container, --color-surface-container-focus, --color-surface-raised, --color-surface-overlay, --color-surface-inverse, --color-surface-inverse-action, --color-accent-subtle: its state fills

## Scales
Read directly by components.
- --space-{1 0.25rem, 2 0.5rem, 4 1rem, 6 1.5rem, 8 2rem, 12 3rem, 16 4rem, 24 6rem}
- --radius-{round 9999px}
- --shape-{xs, sm, md, lg, xl, sheet, 2xl}: corners, a style redraws them
- --stroke-{hairline 1px, rail 2px, ring 2px, ring-gap 2px}
- --duration-{press-in 100ms, press-out 160ms, hover 150ms, state 200ms, enter 250ms, exit 150ms, avatar-hop 900ms, avatar-spark 1100ms, avatar-wiggle 800ms, avatar-look 1500ms, avatar-blink 260ms, avatar-shake 500ms, avatar-bob 1500ms, avatar-work 2400ms, sheet-in 300ms, sheet-out 220ms, drawer-full 500ms, progress 250ms, stagger 40ms, theme 200ms, spin 800ms, spring-settle 650ms, spring-release 750ms, spring-pop 450ms, spring-spatial-fast 350ms, spring-spatial-default 420ms, spring-spatial-slow 570ms, spring-effects-fast 140ms, spring-effects-default 220ms, spring-effects-slow 310ms}
- --ease-{out, in-out, drawer, hover, linear linear, spring-settle, spring-release, spring-pop, spring-spatial-fast, spring-spatial-default, spring-spatial-slow, spring-effects-fast, spring-effects-default, spring-effects-slow}

## Component tokens
Sizes per part: cover (10), rail (12), item (4), cta (7), action (1), button (6), mini (8), player (9), control (6), scrubber (10), hue (6), segmented (5), field (9), switch (9), checkbox (1), sheet (10), toast (6), banner (5), archive (2), chip (17), app (2), queue (1), nav (10), tabs (3), row (4), slider (1), picker (3), scene (16), card (6). List one with `npm run ds -- token <group>`.
